post.summary: Log in as the operator
post.description: Decision 0109: a console account (admin_accounts) is tried first, then the ADMIN_USERNAME bootstrap administrator; a disabled account is ADMIN_LOGIN_INVALID. The response carries the role and its permissions. Username + password (argon2id). Success sets the signed session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/admin, 12 hours). Decision 0110: failures lock per login name (case-insensitive; ADMIN_LOGIN_USERNAME_MAX_FAILURES in a row, default 5, lock ADMIN_LOGIN_USERNAME_LOCK_SECONDS, default 900) and per client address (ADMIN_LOGIN_IP_MAX_FAILURES within ADMIN_LOGIN_IP_WINDOW_SECONDS, default 50 in 900, lock ADMIN_LOGIN_IP_LOCK_SECONDS, default 900): 423 ADMIN_LOGIN_LOCKED with `detailsSafe.scope` (`username` | `ip`), `detailsSafe.retryAfterSeconds`, and `Retry-After`. One name's failures never lock another name. A success clears its name's count. The counters live in PostgreSQL (`admin_login_attempts`), shared by every instance and kept across restarts. Only one login is verified at a time per instance; a concurrent one is 429 ADMIN_LOGIN_BUSY (not counted, `Retry-After: 1`). Counters unavailable → 503 ADMIN_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE (no password is verified).

post.summary: Approve a draft: it becomes the version in force
post.description: Decision 0110: needs `formula.approve` (reviewer only; platform_admin and the bootstrap administrator are 403 ADMIN_ROLE_FORBIDDEN). The approver must not be the draft's author (403 PERMISSION_DENIED, reasonCode ADMIN_FORMULA_SELF_APPROVAL); a draft without a recorded author is 409 ADMIN_CONFLICT (ADMIN_FORMULA_DRAFT_AUTHOR_UNKNOWN; save it again as a new draft). Decision 0111: the reviewer's bound ops operator must be enabled (revoked or account disabled meanwhile: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, reasonCode ADMIN_OPERATOR_DISABLED / ADMIN_ACCOUNT_DISABLED). Audit: `mining.formula.approve.requested` first (cannot be written: 503 ADMIN_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE, nothing approved), then `mining.formula.approve` in the approving transaction or `mining.formula.approve.failed`. Same semantics as the break-glass `pnpm mining:approve-formula` (Decisions 0046, 0111; it records `cli:<name>`, which `approvedBy` shows as null): only `pending_approval` can be approved; the approved version is retired; effectiveAt = now; the draft's community weights are applied in the same transaction. The snapshot lane computes under it from its next run. Refused under NODE_ENV=production (503 MINING_APPROVE_FORBIDDEN_IN_PRODUCTION).

post.summary: Release a blocked MEME v2 snapshot publication for one more try
post.description: Decision 0120 (`console.write`: platform administrator only). For the project's latest MEME v2 instance whose latest snapshot publication attempt is `failed` or `mismatch`, appends an immutable retry grant (releaseId = Idempotency-Key): attempts up to that one stop blocking the `launch2_snapshot_publisher` lane and stop counting against its retry budget, so its next tick starts attempt N + 1 from the chain (the released row stays as evidence; nothing is signed or sent by this route). Refusals: 404 NOT_FOUND (ADMIN_LAUNCH_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, LAUNCH2_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND); 409 ADMIN_CONFLICT with reasonCode LAUNCH2_SNAPSHOT_NOTHING_TO_RETRY (no attempt yet), LAUNCH2_SNAPSHOT_NOT_RETRYABLE (latest attempt pending / broadcast / confirmed; detailsSafe.status), LAUNCH2_SNAPSHOT_ALREADY_RELEASED, LAUNCH2_SNAPSHOT_ALREADY_ON_CHAIN (a root is indexed), LAUNCH2_SNAPSHOT_CLOSED_NO_HOLDERS, ADMIN_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (same key, other project / reason / actor). Same key + same body replays (`replayed: true`). Audit: `launch.snapshot.retry.requested` before (when it cannot be written: 503 ADMIN_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE, nothing runs), then `.decided` or `.failed`.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Lower-case UUIDv4. The same key with the same body replays the first result (`replayed: true`); with another body or actor it is 409 ADMIN_CONFLICT (ADMIN_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT / OPS_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT).

post.description: Decision 0109 (`testnet.accept`: testnet_acceptor only). post.summary: Upload a launch desk campaign cover
post.description: Decision 0140: multipart/form-data with one part `file`. PNG / JPEG / WebP by content (HEIC refused), ≤ 2 MiB, at least 600 × 300 (1200 × 600 recommended); stored as a 1200 × 600 WebP (2:1 centre crop, metadata stripped) in media_objects (kind campaign_cover, no LOOP user owner). Refusal: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED CAMPAIGN_COVER_INVALID with detailsSafe.mediaReasonCode MEDIA_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED | MEDIA_TOO_LARGE | MEDIA_DIMENSIONS_TOO_SMALL | MEDIA_DECODE_FAILED. 201 {mediaId, coverUrl}; write mediaId into coverMediaId. Not audited by itself (the campaign create / update that references it is). console.write (platform_admin).

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Optional lower-case UUIDv4. Create and cover upload: the same key with the same body (cover: the same bytes) replays the first result (create: 200 `replayed: true`); another body is 409 ADMIN_CONFLICT / ADMIN_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Update / publish / archive accept it and do not deduplicate (a repeated publish / archive is 409 CAMPAIGN_STATUS_CONFLICT; a repeated full PATCH writes the same values again).
